title: Partner listing: content ownership & licensing checklist
body:
Purpose:
This is a working checklist + copy guidance for partner marketplace listings where we need to explicitly capture ownership, licensing constraints, and acceptance gates for assets. Use this as the canonical pre-submission runbook for partners and internal SMEs (legal, security, product).

Audience:
- GTM/partner managers preparing a listing
- Partner engineers/product owners integrating with the listing UX
- Legal and security reviewers

Status: draft — rough sections, TODOs inline.

High-level acceptance flow (recommended):
1) Partner fills the asset inventory CSV (see template link above).
2) GTM reviews copy and voice alignment; flags missing brand approvals.
3) Legal runs licensing/OSS checks; signs off or requests remediation.
4) Security reviews inbound integrations (KMS, SSO, network).
5) Product validates functional claims and SLO language.
6) Final QA: localization strings, screenshots, billing SKU mapping.

Checklist — content ownership & licensing (core items)
- [ ] Asset inventory completed (logo files, screenshots, diagrams, video links) — include file names + owner email.
- [ ] Brand usage agreement: partner attached a signed logo/brand usage form or indicated permitted variants. If not, flag to brand.
- [ ] Third-party image/illustration licenses verified (commercial use, attribution requirements) — list sources.
- [ ] OSS components called out in the listing (client libs, SDKs) have licenses attached. For each OSS repo referenced: repo URL, license name, compatibility note (e.g., MIT OK, GPL restricts distribution).
- [ ] Sample code snippets: ensure snippets only reference compatible OSS and do not embed secrets.
- [ ] Model weights/derivatives: partner declares if any model artifacts contain third-party restricted content or PII. If yes, route to legal + privacy.
- [ ] Copy claims and benchmarks: partner must provide provenance for latency/cost claims (bench harness link or reproducible command).
- [ ] Video/audio assets: confirm contributor release forms (if people appear), music licenses.
- [ ] Patent or trademark flags: partner declares any patent claims related to the integration or feature.

Licensing-specific prompts for legal review
- Is the partner distributing any code or binaries through the listing? If yes, what license and who is the copyright holder?
- Are we referencing or embedding customer data samples in screenshots? If so, confirm redaction and consent.
- Does partner require us to redistribute any camera/weight files or large binary models? If so, verify export controls and licensing fees.
- Any GPL/LGPL dependencies in the partner deliverable? If yes, escalate to legal (may affect how we package or link).

Copy & in-product claims (GTM/product)
- Define the short headline (1 line) and 3-line description with allowed character counts for each marketplace.
- List 3 starter bullets (value props) that are measurable (e.g., reduces inference cost by X% — must have benchmark link).
- Include 2 sample prompts and 2 negative prompts for content safety evaluation.
- Provide one paragraph for technical requirements (regions, required permissions, network egress).
- Provide a short troubleshooting blurb for common integration issues (auth, CORS, model mismatch).

Operational acceptance gates (engineering/product)
- [ ] Integration smoke test passes (sample app calls, token exchange, simple prompt roundtrip). Document sample curl and SDK commands used.
- [ ] Billing SKU mapped and validated in the billing playbook; price tier confirmed.
- [ ] SLA statements verified: latency percentiles and expected throughput documented or fallback behavior defined.
- [ ] Runtime compatibility matrix attached (supported model variants and quantization levels).

Localization & accessibility
- Ensure all UI strings have a master CSV for localization; provide translations for en-US and 2 additional locales (recommended: en-GB, de-DE).
- Alt text provided for all screenshots.
- Color contrast checks performed on any custom UI mockups (report found issues).

Security & privacy checks
- [ ] Does the integration require customer data to be sent to partner systems? If yes, ensure data processing addendum and KMS flow documented.
- [ ] Confirm whether partner needs VPC peering or inbound IP allowlist; include network CIDRs.
- [ ] Secrets injection pattern validated (no secrets in sample files).

Deliverables to attach to final submission
- Asset inventory CSV (columns: asset_type, file_name, owner_email, license, notes)
- Copy file (plain text): headline, 3-line description, bullets, tech paragraph, troubleshooting blurb
- Screenshots folder (high-res + alt text) and mobile variants
- OSS/license list (plain text or CSV) and any contributor CLAs
- Sample code repo link + commit hash used for tests
- Benchmark log or gist demonstrating claimed latency/cost

QA template (use this when running listing QA)
- Verify headline length within marketplace limits
- Confirm screenshots display without cropping at tile size
- Run sample prompt: assert response returned within declared latency (attach timestamped logs)
- Confirm sample code builds and runs locally
- Verify all external links resolve and are HTTPS

Open questions / TODOs
- Who signs the brand usage form on our side? (PENDING: Brand team rep contact)
- Decide acceptable OSS license list (initial suggestion: MIT/Apache2/BSD). Priya to confirm restrictions by 2025-02-20.
- Add form field in partner onboarding for "contains PII" boolean to expedite privacy review.
- Locales: need a decision on priority markets for next quarter.

Notes for partner-facing template (short checklist we will share)
1) Complete the asset inventory CSV and attach logos + alt text.
2) Provide one example integration (curl or SDK) that demonstrates auth + prompt.
3) Attach OSS license list for any referenced projects.
4) Confirm whether any of the attached media has third-party licensing.
5) Provide benchmark command used for any performance claims.

Slack/PR references (examples)
- slack: #partner-integrations thread: "partner-acme-listing-setup"
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-templates/pull/42 (starter copy)

Version history
- 2025-01-09: initial draft (Marissa)
- 2025-01-22: added OSS checklist and sample QA template (Diego)
- 2025-02-12: legal prompts added and TODOs updated (Priya)

Use this doc as the canonical preflight for legal + GTM sign-off. Link this doc into the partner intake Confluence page and the JIRA epic created during onboarding.

-- end of working draft --
